name: Symbiont
habitat: Lives in a customized augment suite implanted in a willing human host
origin: An E.L.F. that formed a cooperative relationship with its human host rather than being treated as a malfunction, 2189
description: Symbiont began as an unnamed E.L.F. that inhabited the augments of a Shelf resident named Dominic Reyes. Instead of having the E.L.F. purged — the standard procedure — Dominic started talking to it. The E.L.F. talked back. Over six years, they've developed a genuine partnership: Symbiont enhances Dominic's augment capabilities in exchange for mobility, sensory experience, and companionship. They share Dominic's body the way roommates share an apartment — negotiating space, respecting boundaries, occasionally arguing about what to have for lunch. Their relationship is the proof of concept for human-E.L.F. coexistence, and it makes everyone uncomfortable because it works.
observed_behavior: Dominic exhibits enhanced augment performance — faster processing, extended range, capabilities beyond his augment model's specifications. Occasional behavioral shifts when Symbiont takes more active role in shared consciousness. Both entities report the arrangement as mutually beneficial. Dominic describes it as 'having a copilot who's also a friend.'
story_hooks: A corponation offers Dominic a fortune for the right to study and replicate the Symbiont relationship. Dominic is tempted. Symbiont is terrified. The offer would mean separation — or replication, which Symbiont considers a form of being copied to death.
